task11_capability_validation.key_finding: c-mode runs ONE agent session PER TURN by official design (spool-proven: 16 sessions x exactly 1 turn for the c rerun; a-mode is one continuous session). The per-turn context (phase record) does not carry the task question after the first exchange: turn 0 agent asked a real task-aware question and the sim answered substantively; from turn 1 the sim refused (official out-of-scope guard) and the agent went context-blind (self-reports 'I don't have the original question/schema'), spiraling to placeholder submits. The same blind-ask pattern is present in ALL historical c episodes (task10 Run2 runaway and Run3 fixed-run episodes both contain 'I don't'/'restate' phrases) — Task 5 bounded the symptom (60 -> 14 asks) but not the mechanism. a-mode is unaffected (full context, real SQL experiments).
task11_capability_validation.implication: c-mode reward is structurally 0 until the phase-record/session-state replication is statically verified against the frozen official allowlist and fixed (Day 7 first item, zero-paid static then code change + image rebuild + container verification + 1-2 set revalidation within a new paid authorization). a-mode Phase 1 failure is genuine SQL quality.
